widgets_values: Photorealistic video of the same adult person as in the reference photograph, performing the driving video's choreography and facial expressions at the exact timing. Consistent identity in every frame: stable face, clear eyes and irises, natural lips, natural skin texture, same hairline, outfit, body proportions, lighting and background. The mouth follows the driving video exactly: closed lips stay closed, and when the mouth opens, the lips and teeth look natural and evenly aligned. Faithful full-body motion with natural fingers, wrists, elbows, shoulders, legs and feet, smooth and temporally coherent.

widgets_values: Chạy thủ công với video 30 FPS CFR có đủ 600 frame. Runner tự chuẩn hóa video và xuất Full HD dọc bằng FFmpeg. Bản này render với bound 704 và dùng checkpoint diffusion FP8 để giảm RAM. GPU Cloud Runner tự chọn SageAttention phù hợp với GPU.
